newsitem.title: USA: Nine West has higher net, to open about 240 stores.
newsitem.headline: Nine West has higher net, to open about 240 stores.

text.p: Nine West Group Inc., reporting higher first-quarter earnings, said Thursday it plans to open about 140 U.S. stores and about 100 stores overseas in 1997.

The maker and retailer of women's shoes had first-quarter earnings of $17.5 million, or 48 cents a share, on revenues of $406.1 million. A year earlier it earned $15.0 million, or 41 cents a share, on revenues of $355.9 million.
The company said it has secured commitments on about 125 of its planned 140 U.S. stores.
Nine West currently operates 997 of its own domestic retail stores and 107 international retail locations. Its shoes are also sold in more than 7,000 department and independent stores.
Nine West brands include the Nine West label, Amalfi, Bandolino, cK/Calvin Klein Shoes, Easy Spirit, Enzo Angiolini, Evan Picone, 9 & Co., Papagallo, Selby and Westies.
Nine West's stock was down 87.5 cents at $37.875 in midday trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
